problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ 5\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 4\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14065173/assets/4eb4b3533453f1a2c08c98bb8e6fd63e3f93563a4a2d56ecc0c0caef225b82e3.png)
examples.worked_solution:
We need to find $x_1,$ $x_2,$ and $x_3$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{b}_{1}+{x}_{2}{b}_{2}+{x}_{3}{b}_{3} & =x \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -9 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -1 \\ 1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 7 \\ 6\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Writing the above system as an augmented matrix $M$ and reducing using Gaussian elimination, we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & -9 & -1 & 7 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 & 6\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-1){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & -9 & -1 & 7 \\ 0 & -3 & 1 & 5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-\frac{1}{3}){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & -9 & -1 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & \frac{4}{3} & \frac{8}{3}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}=1 \\ -9{x}_{2}-{x}_{3}=7 \\ \frac{4}{3}{x}_{3}=\frac{8}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get $x_3 =2.$ Substituting this into the second equation, we obtain

$$
-9x_2 - 2 = 7 \qquad\Longrightarrow\qquad x_2 = -1,
$$

and substituting $x_2=-1$ into the first equation, we get

$$
x_1+3(-1) = 1 \qquad\Longrightarrow\quad x_1 = 4.
$$

feedback.problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2}},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -5 \\ 6\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2 \\ 4\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -4 \\ 5\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
We need to find ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ such that  

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{b}_{1}+{x}_{2}{b}_{2} & =x \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -5 \\ 6\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2 \\ 4\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -4 \\ 5\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The equation above gives the system with the augmented matrix

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & 2 \\ -5 & -2 & -4 \\ 6 & 4 & 5\end{aligned}].
$$

Row-reducing the matrix using Gaussian elimination, we obtain the following: 

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & 2 \\ -5 & -2 & -4 \\ 6 & 4 & 5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+\frac{5}{2}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & 2 \\ 0 & 8 & 1 \\ 6 & 4 & 5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & 2 \\ 0 & 8 & 1 \\ 0 & -8 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & 2 \\ 0 & 8 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

 

The system is now 

$$
{\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2}=2 \\ 8{x}_{2}=1.\end{aligned}
$$

From the second equation, we get ${x}_{2}=\frac{1}{8}.$ Substituting this into the first equation, we obtain

$$
2{x}_{1}+4\cdot \frac{1}{8}=2\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=\frac{3}{4}.
$$

Therefore, $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}\frac{3}{4} \\ \frac{1}{8}\end{aligned}].$ 

Finally, ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=\frac{3}{4}+\frac{1}{8}=\frac{7}{8}.$
